name: keycast
title: Keycast
description: Keystrokes and clicks drawn over the screen for a recording or a screen share: the recent keys as caps (modifiers as glyphs, a repeat as ×3) fading from a corner, a ring around the cursor with a ripple on every click. Keys, cursor, or both; shortcuts only when typing should stay private; a red dot on the bar while it runs.
author: pal

settings.label: Default mode
settings.description: What Start draws when no mode is named: the key strip, the cursor ring, or both.

settings.label: Key strip position
settings.description: Which corner of the display under the cursor the keys stack in.

settings.label: Scale
settings.description: The size of the caps and the ring; 1 is the panel's own key cap at twice its size.

settings.label: Hold
settings.description: How long a key stays on screen after its last press.

settings.label: Keys shown
settings.description: How many recent entries the strip keeps; the oldest leaves past it.

settings.label: Shortcuts only
settings.text: Show a key only with cmd, ctrl or alt, or a function or navigation key; plain typing stays off the screen

settings.label: Cursor ring
settings.text: A ring around the cursor while the cursor mode is on (clicks ripple either way)

settings.label: Ring colour
settings.description: The ring's and the left click's colour, from the tag palette; a right click ripples in amber.

settings.label: Click ripples
settings.text: A ripple spreads from the cursor on every click, left and right told apart

mode.description: What it draws while on: keys, cursor or both; null while off

toggle.description: Start keycast, or stop it when it is on (in another mode: switch)

mode.description: keys, cursor or both; the Default mode setting without it

start.description: Start keycast (switch the mode when it is on)

mode.description: keys, cursor or both; the Default mode setting without it

keycast.title: Keycast
keycast.description: Start or stop the overlay, pick what it draws, flip shortcuts-only; the row that asks for Input Monitoring when it is missing.

keys.title: Start or stop; on a mode row, start in (or switch to) that mode

active.title: Recording
active.description: A red dot while keycast is on, with what it draws; hidden otherwise. The popover: the three modes as tiles, the shortcuts-only switch, Stop.

store.tagline: Keystrokes and clicks on screen for a recording or a screen share
features: The recent keys as caps at a corner of the display under the cursor: ⌃ ⌥ ⇧ ⌘ as glyphs, named keys as their symbols (↵ ⇥ ⌫ → F5), a repeat folded into one cap with ×3, each fading after the hold
A ring around the cursor and a ripple on every click, left and right told apart, on a full-screen pass-through overlay that follows the cursor across displays
Keys, cursor, or both; shortcuts only (cmd, ctrl, alt, function and navigation keys) when what is typed should stay off the screen; nothing is ever shown while a secure text field has the keyboard
Start and Stop in the palette, `pal://keycast/toggle?mode=keys|cursor|both` for a keybind, a red dot on the bar while it runs whose popover switches the mode and stops it
Corner, scale, hold, length, ring colour and ripples as settings

actions.title: Start / Stop
actions.description: The overlay on in the default mode, or off.

actions.title: Keys only / Cursor only / Keys and cursor
actions.description: Start in that mode, or switch to it while on.

actions.title: Shortcuts only
actions.description: Flip the setting: plain typing off the screen.
